title: Українське питання на сторінках часопису «Вестник Європи» у 1860–1900-х рр.
venue: Актуальні питання гуманітарних наук: міжвузівський збірник наукових праць молодих вчених Дрогобицького державного педагогічного університету імені Івана Франка
extended_summary:
This paper examines how the Russian journal Vestnik Yevropy discussed the Ukrainian question during the 1860s–1890s. The author asks how the periodical represented Ukrainian history, language, education, literature, and the broader national movement, especially in comparison with dominant Russian imperial narratives and anti-Ukrainian reactions in the press and official circles.

The article is a historical-literary and historiographical analysis of selected writings by Mykola Kostomarov, Mykhailo Drahomanov, Oleksandr Pypin, and other contributors published in the journal. It traces their arguments about the historical distinctiveness of Ukrainians, the development of the Ukrainian language, the legitimacy of Ukrainian literature, the role of folk culture and ethnography, and debates over education in Ukrainian. The text also discusses related controversies such as the Ems Ukaz, censorship, and responses to Ukrainian cultural activism in Galicia and Kyiv.

The paper is not an empirical education study; rather, it synthesizes journal content to show the evolution of pro-Ukrainian arguments within a major imperial liberal publication. Its main conclusion is that Vestnik Yevropy was one of the few all-Russian journals to give sustained attention to Ukrainian language and culture, helped normalize the idea of Ukrainian historical and cultural distinctiveness, and reflected the transition of the Ukrainian movement from cultural to political forms. It also shows that censorship and imperial resistance continued to limit acceptance of Ukrainian language and scholarship.
quality_tier_rationale: This is a historical/historiographical article about the Ukrainian question in the journal *Vestnik Yevropy*, not an intervention study. It does not evaluate a technology or AI-supported educational treatment, so there is no experimental or observational intervention methodology to rate.
impact_tier_rationale: The paper has no measured educational or technological impact; it is descriptive historical analysis. There are no outcome data, effect sizes, or assessed intervention effects relevant to K-12 education.
